findings.evidence: Hom.lean:87 `change (Grp.homMk'' (A := Grp.mk A.toOver) (B := Grp.mk B.toOver) f one_f mul_f).hom.hom = f`; Hom.lean:96-98 `lemma Hom.toOverHom_def ... : Hom.toOverHom f = f.hom.hom.hom.hom := rfl` with the docstring quoted above; Hom.lean:104/112/119 show the intended `rw [Hom.toOverHom_def]` idiom. Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Grp.lean:145-151 defines `homMk''` with `@[simps!]`, so `Grp.homMk''_hom_hom` is a simp lemma and no manual `change` is needed to expose it.
findings.fix: Replace the `change` with `rw [Hom.toOverHom_def, Hom.mk']` (or `simp [Hom.mk', Hom.toOverHom_def, Grp.homMk''_hom_hom]`), so this proof uses the documented projection lemma like `one_hom`/`mul_hom`/`inv_hom`/`ext` already do. If some step genuinely cannot be reached that way, the comment must say which one and why.
findings.issue: `Hom.toOverHom_mk'` crosses the InducedCategory/CommGrp/Grp wrappers with `change ... .hom.hom = f`, contradicting the file's own stated rule at lines 91-95 that `Hom.toOverHom_def` is "the single place recording that definitional equality; other proofs should go through it rather than unfolding the wrappers again". The comment at 85-86 motivates the lemma, not the `change`.

summary: One proof unfolds the nested category wrappers with a bare `change` even though the file itself declares `Hom.toOverHom_def` as the single place that defeq may be crossed; the attached comment explains why the lemma exists, not why `change` is unavoidable.
